caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate glass or crystal decanter with a stopper. The decanter is shown in a mostly vertical orientation, occupying the center of the page, with the handle to the right and the spout to the left. The body of the decanter features a spiraling, diagonal pattern made up of raised ridges and textured strips, as well as layered, faceted diamond shapes near the base and top. The stopper at the top is spherical with prominent, symmetrical vertical ridges and a textured surface, and it fits into a wide neck with two circular rings below. The handle is attached to the upper part of the neck and curves outward, attaching to the side of the decanter. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of light blue, grey, and white, giving the appearance of glass or crystal. The shadowed areas are depicted with blue-grey tones, and the highlights are left white to suggest shine and transparency. Below the decanter, the words "ACTUAL SIZE" are written in all capital letters. In the bottom left corner, the text "R. ELVIS" is written as a signature. The background is blank except for light discoloration around the edges.
title: Cruet
